agent_vs_you: Turn 1 was fine. In turn 2 the agent correctly reused small_steps_final.mp4 rather than remaking it, but sent it to assemble with a long extra ('fit entire source proportionally without cropping ... solid navy background above and below'). assemble always scales to fill and crops: its catalogue line promises order, length and aspect, never fitting or padding. The catalogue has a line for exactly this case: crop with extra 'fit: contain' keeps ALL of a clip in a new size and adds 'plain' for a plain fill. The agent likely picked assemble because the request was framed as 'a single-clip layout on a canvas' and assemble 'sets the aspect'. Even crop would not have given NAVY: its plain fill samples the clip's top edge, which here is light grey (#a19fa0), and no colour can be named, so the navy part needs a small harness change.

your_plan.say: I'll put your existing video, untouched and whole, in the middle of a vertical TikTok frame with plain navy above and below. Same timing, still silent.

params.prompt_or_change: Fit the whole widescreen video, unscaled in shape and uncropped, centred in a vertical frame; plain navy above and below; same duration and timing.

steps.why: Code, 0 credits: every frame of the delivered clip kept whole and in time, words included; the navy needs the colour fix below (today plain = the clip's top-edge colour).

fix: 1) Harness (crop.js): accept a named or hex fill colour with fit: contain (extra 'colour: navy|#1F2A44'), else fall back to the edge colour; sample top and bottom edges separately when no colour is named. Don't add an audio track to a silent clip. 2) Catalogue: on assemble add CANNOT 'fit or pad a picture or clip: it always crops to fill; use crop with fit: contain'; add to the CHOOSING line 'RESIZE what was just delivered (letterbox, pillarbox, padding of a colour) -> crop fit: contain'. 3) Harness: assemble should refuse or report extras it cannot honour (fit, padding, background colour) instead of returning success.
evidence: small_steps_final.mp4 (turn 1) is 858x480, 8.0 s, no audio stream: an orange robot watering a potted plant on a light grey background with 'Small steps' on a dark box at the top. small_steps_tiktok.mp4 is 720x1280, 8.0 s: a centre crop that cuts the robot at the left and the plant and spout at the right, with no navy anywhere, plus a silent audio track. The source's top-edge colour is #a19fa0 (light grey) and bottom #bb9e8d, so crop's current 'plain' fill would also not be navy.
